Lando Norris feels it's "nice to know there's a possibility" he could stay in the battle to retain his Formula 1 world championship, after taking pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix. ​​​​​​The McLaren driver produced a dominant race victory in the final race before the sport's summer break in Hungary and made it two successive pole positions by topping qualifying in Zandvoort on Saturday. Man Utd boss Michael Carrick focused on the "good things" his side had done despite a dismal 2-0 defeat at newly-promoted Hull City on the opening day of the new season. United were outfought and outplayed by a Hull side widely tipped to return to the Sky Bet Championship this season at the MKM Stadium, with two goals from set pieces giving the Tigers a richly deserved victory and their first over United in more than half a century. The loss punctured the optimism around Old Trafford at the start of Carrick's first full season in charge.
